aarti.tek: Lord Śrī Viśvakarmā, come to this home; Lord Viśvakarmā.
aarti.pad1: You heard Sudāmā's plea and built palaces of gold. Giving every good thing, Lord, you took away the sorrows of the sorrowing. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Lord Kṛṣṇa made a request: build the city of Dvārakā. You protected the cowherd boys and saved the Lord's honour. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Śrī Rāma worshipped you; then you bound and built the bridge. You carried the whole army across and, Lord, brought about the victory at Laṅkā. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Hear of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's victory; Lord, come and grant me the sight of you. Give me the light of the knowledge of craft, and make my life fruitful. ॥4॥
